title: ConfigPublicContactDocument
description: Server-only public contact record stored at config/publicContact. The website reads it through its Firestore viewer identity and renders only supportEmail; a missing, invalid or unreadable document falls back to the source-controlled brand address. website/src/content/publicContact.ts parses exactly this shape.
x-owner: website public contact operator (bounded operator transaction with Firestore IAM writer authority)

revision.description: Monotonic revision the operator raises on every change.

supportEmail.description: Lower-case mailbox safe to place in a mailto href. Must not contain two consecutive dots.
